children: CannaPharmaRX reported third-quarter net income of $645,416, primarily from non-cash fair value gains, as operating expenses fell 54.6%.
Q3 revenue declined 79.0% to $137,705, partly because a shipment was deferred to October.
Q3 operating loss was $532,943; fair value gains did not provide cash to fund operations.
Nine-month net loss narrowed 54.1% to $1.65 million, while revenue declined 14.9% to $1.04 million.
At September 30, cash was $32,037 and working capital deficiency was $30.9 million; substantial doubt exists about going concern.
Management plans to seek debt and/or equity financing, with no assurance of availability; equity issuance could dilute shareholders.

title: CannaPharmaRX Reports Q3 Net Income on Non-Cash Gains, Lower Expenses
